1.name: Aggu
1.mla_note: Regular member; won the 15 December 2025 new election held after the 27 October 2025 vote tied (Joanna Quassa and Erasmus Ivvalu, 105 votes each)
1.result_note: tie; a new election under s. 149(2) of the Nunavut Elections Act was held on 15 December 2025
1.population_basis: 2021 census population of the constituency's communities (Statistics Canada), Iqaluit, Arviat, Rankin Inlet and Igloolik shared between their constituencies by electors on the list at the 2025 election, scaled to Statistics Canada's latest Nunavut estimate by the ratio of that estimate to the census total
